source_quote: Kalam Labs has raised a preseed round of $450,000 in funding for its livestreaming platform
notes: The company has pivoted to stratospheric defence drones. Search snippets say it has raised about $2M led by Lightspeed (YourStory, Nov 2025; fetch got 403), which points to money raised after the pre-seed, but no date. Tracxn lists a $222K angel round from Aman Gupta on 2026-01-12, apparently a Shark Tank India deal, also unverified. The BusinessToday Shark Tank article shows only the ask (Rs 2 crore for 0.67%). Left null because the extra money cannot be dated.
